evidence.ACL: there is complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament
evidence.MCL: There is grade I ligamentous sprain of the medial collateral ligament.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: complex tear in a buckethandle type at body and posterior horn with flipped meniscus toward intercondylar region.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: there are horizontal tear at the anterior horn, body and focal radial tear at the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus
evidence.Lateral OA: There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury.
evidence.PF OA: the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion.
evidence.Contusion: There is no fracture or bone contusion.
evidence.Fracture: There is no fracture or bone contusion.
